#NMDS

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}

#Bray
set.seed(1)
ord <- metaMDS(otu_table(ps_fringilla), distance = "bray", k = 8, binary = FALSE)

#Call:
#metaMDS(comm = otu_table(ps_fringilla), distance = "bray", k = 8,      binary = FALSE) 

#global Multidimensional Scaling using monoMDS

#Data:     wisconsin(sqrt(otu_table(ps_fringilla))) 
#Distance: bray 

#Dimensions: 8 
#Stress:     0.09619446 
#Stress type 1, weak ties
#Best solution was not repeated after 20 tries
#The best solution was from try 1 (random start)
#Scaling: centring, PC rotation, halfchange scaling 
#Species: expanded scores based on ‘wisconsin(sqrt(otu_table(ps_fringilla)))’ 

scrs <- scores(ord, display = 'sites')

scrs <- cbind(as.data.frame(scrs), Species_Label = sample_data(ps_fringilla)$Species_Label)

cent <- aggregate(cbind(NMDS1, NMDS2) ~ Species_Label, data = scrs, FUN = mean)

segs <- merge(scrs, setNames(cent, c('Species_Label','oNMDS1','oNMDS2')),
              by = 'Species_Label', sort = FALSE)


cent$fSpecies_Label <- factor(cent$Species_Label, levels = c("El_Hierro_F_c_ombriosa", "Flores_F_moreletti", "Gran_Canaria_F_c_bakeri", "Gran_Canaria_F_polatzeki", "La_Gomera_F_c_canariensis", "La_Palma_F_c_palmae", "Madeira_F_maderensis" , "Mainland_F_coelebs", "Sao_Miguel_F_moreletti", "Tenerife_F_c_canariensis", "Tenerife_F_teydea"), labels = c("El~Hierro:~italic('F.c. ombriosa')","Flores:~italic('F. moreletti')","Gran~Canaria:~italic('F.c. bakeri')","Gran~Canaria:~italic('F. polatzeki')","La~Gomera:~italic('F.c. canariensis')","La~Palma:~italic('F.c. palmae')","Madeira:~italic('F. maderensis')","Mainland:~italic('F. coelebs')","Sao~Miguel:~italic('F. moreletti')","Tenerife:~italic('F.c. canariensis')","Tenerife:~italic('F. teydea')"))


png(paste0(outputDir, "/Figures/bray_NMDS_species_speciesFix.png"), width = 320, height = 240, units = "mm", res = 1000)

(bray_NMDS <- ggplot(scrs, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, fill = Species_Label,  shape= Species_Label)) +
  #geom_segment(data = segs, mapping = aes(xend = oNMDS1, yend = oNMDS2), alpha = 0.2) + # spiders
    geom_point(alpha=1,size=10, stroke =1.5,  color = "white") + 
    geom_point(data=cent, aes(y=NMDS2,x=NMDS1,fill=Species_Label),size=17, stroke =1.5, color = "black") +
  pca_theme + SpeciesLabel.fill + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01))+
 scale_shape_manual(values = c(21,22,23,21, 23, 25, 21,21, 21, 22, 25), guide = "none")+
  #geom_label_repel(data = cent, aes(label = fSpecies_Label,color = Species_Label), size=rel(5), nudge_y = 0.0005, nudge_x = 0.0005, fill = "white", parse = TRUE) +
  guides(color = "none"))

dev.off()

```

## Test effect of population, species, sex and age

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}

ps_fringilla <- ps_fringilla  %>% subset_samples(Genus == "Fringilla") %>% subset_samples(!is.na(Sex)) %>% subset_samples(Age > 0) %>% removeZeros()

df <- meta(ps_fringilla)
head(df,3)
table(df$Species)

# Jaccard
jaccard_dist <- vegdist(otu_table(ps_fringilla), method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)

set.seed(42)
(ad <- adonis2(jaccard_dist~ Species_Label + Age_cat + Sex, data = meta(ps_fringilla),by = "margin", permutations = 9999))

#Permutation test for adonis under reduced model
#Marginal effects of terms
#Permutation: free
#Number of permutations: 9999

#adonis2(formula = jaccard_dist ~ Species_Label + Age_cat + Sex, data = meta(ps_fringilla), permutations = 9999, by = "margin")
#               Df SumOfSqs      R2      F Pr(>F)    
#Species_Label  10    9.144 0.11010 2.3878 0.0001 ***
#Age_cat         1    0.322 0.00388 0.8404 0.9368    
#Sex             1    0.353 0.00425 0.9209 0.7217    
#Residual      189   72.377 0.87149                  
#Total         201   83.050 1.00000                  
#---
#Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
```
